preheader: Nvidia faces subpoena threat; Mercor hits $20B valuation; McKinsey forecasts air travel slowdown.

lead.headline: House Lawmakers Threaten Subpoena for Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang
lead.body: Three Republican House committee chairmen are threatening to subpoena former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang over chip exports and national security concerns. The regulatory pressure comes as Nvidia sits 30% below its October peak, erasing $1.5 trillion in market value following Huang's exit.
lead.why: Watching how geopolitical probes impact Big Tech valuations shows how regulatory decisions directly move financial markets.

stories.headline: October Wholesale Inflation Rises Slower Than Expected
stories.body: U.S. producer prices rose 0.4% in October, coming in slightly softer than Wall Street estimates. While inflation pressures remain, the lower reading eased investor concerns about aggressive Federal Reserve interest rate hikes.
stories.why: Analyzing wholesale price shifts helps you evaluate corporate margin pressures in your finance and accounting courses.

stories.headline: Kraken Parent Payward Reports 67% Drop in Q3 Earnings
stories.body: Payward reported a 67% annual drop in third-quarter adjusted earnings as cryptocurrency trading volume slowed. Despite the financial drop, the firm plans to expand into new markets.
stories.why: This illustrates how fee-dependent fintech platforms remain vulnerable to trading volume cycles during quiet market periods.

stories.headline: AI Chip Startup Fractile Raises $720M at $7B Valuation
stories.body: British startup Fractile closed a $720 million Series C funding round to build hardware for artificial intelligence. Venture investors continue placing large bets on physical chip infrastructure to challenge existing market leaders.
stories.why: Tracking hardware investments helps you see where venture capitalists see long-term opportunities beyond software applications.

stories.headline: Apple Releases HomeView Smart Display and New Apple TV 4K
stories.body: Apple officially launched its new HomeView smart home display alongside a fourth-generation Apple TV 4K. Both products hit store shelves on Friday after opening for pre-orders in mid-October.
stories.why: Observing product rollout schedules provides real-world context for technology marketing and ecosystem hardware strategies.

stories.headline: McKinsey Report Forecasts Air Travel Growth Slowdown
stories.body: A new McKinsey survey reveals that 56% of airlines expect air travel growth to slow over the next two to three years. The firm cites elevated jet fuel prices, rising maintenance costs, and aircraft delivery delays as primary causes.
stories.why: Studying how consulting firms break down macroeconomic headwinds gives you insight into the analytical frameworks used in case interviews.

stories.headline: AI Automation Reduces Entry-Level Finance Roles
stories.body: Regional hubs like Bournemouth are seeing entry-level back-office finance jobs cut as companies automate routine processing tasks. Industry analysts advise young professionals to focus on adaptability and critical judgment to stay competitive.
stories.why: As you prepare for internship recruiting, this highlights the importance of pursuing advisory skills that basic software cannot replace.

stories.headline: Anteaters Men's Basketball Dominates Lincoln 90-40
stories.body: UC Irvine men's basketball team remained undefeated after a 90-40 victory against Lincoln University at the Bren Events Center. UCI opened the game with 19 unanswered points and held a 71-29 rebounding advantage.

stories.headline: Top Seeds Zverev and Alcaraz Headline ATP Finals Draw
stories.body: The top eight men's tennis players gathered in Turin, Italy for the season-ending ATP Finals starting Sunday. World No. 1 Alexander Zverev and second seed Carlos Alcaraz were placed in separate groups for round-robin play.

term.name: Producer Price Index (PPI)
term.definition: The Producer Price Index measures the average change over time in the selling prices received by domestic producers for their output. Unlike consumer price indexes that measure retail store prices, PPI tracks wholesale inflation before costs reach consumers.

serve.headline: Mercor raises $750M at $20B valuation for AI hiring platform
serve.body: Artificial intelligence startup Mercor raised $750 million in new funding, raising its valuation to $20 billion. The company was founded by 23-year-old entrepreneurs Adarsh Hiremath and Surya Midha.
